steps: finding: Fresh exact-ID geometry can legitimately change between monthly releases; preserved EA metric is tied to an older geometry.
require: hash current geometry and compare with preserved HMLR feature/geometry receipt
require: record area and bounds deltas
require: invalidate direct 0.001m preserved metric comparison after material geometry change
require: require fresh baseline/reconciliation when geometry changes
require: do not call a changed polygon numeric mismatch an EA source failure
finding: HMLR publishes multiple INSPIRE polygon datasets; current generic matcher accepts arbitrary vector inputs.
require: bind promotion to Index polygons spatial data INSPIRE dataset family
require: record dataset landing/download URL and publication date
require: reject Local Land Charges INSPIRE or other HMLR polygon families
require: bind authority archive to Index Polygons catalogue SHA
require: retain dataset-family identifier in exact-match receipt
finding: OS supplies Metadata_<tile>.xml with flying dates, processing date, version and lineage; current crosschecker ignores it.
require: extract Metadata_<tile>.xml for every required tile
require: parse processing date separately from real-world survey date
require: parse tile version/reason/lineage and bind to ASC SHA
finding: OS per-tile metadata identifies product, grid representation, tile reference, BNG and ODN; current code does not validate it.
require: require product name OS Terrain 50
require: require spatial representation grid DTM
require: require metadata tile reference equals TQ27/TQ39/TQ59 member
require: require EPSG:27700 and EPSG:5701 references
require: bind metadata identity to ASC/PRJ/GML SHAs
finding: OS specifies Terrain50 grid heights to nearest 0.1m; current raster sampling accepts arbitrary numeric precision.
require: audit every valid ASC height token against 0.1m quantisation tolerance
require: exclude declared nodata from precision audit
require: block materially non-Terrain50 precision patterns
require: bind precision audit to ASC SHA
finding: Rasterio exposes per-band scales, offsets and units; sampler currently reads raw band values without checking them.
require: record dataset.scales offsets and units for selected band
require: apply non-default scale/offset before statistics or block if unsupported
require: require resulting unit compatible with metres
require: bind scale/offset/unit receipt to GeoTIFF SHA and RangeType
require: compute extrema/quantiles from physical elevation values
finding: Rasterio all_touched=False can include center pixels and Bresenham-selected pixels; contract requires valid pixel centres inside the polygon.
require: derive selected pixel-center coordinates from affine transform
require: apply explicit geometric center-in-polygon test
require: compare explicit center set with rasterio mask set
require: exclude any Bresenham-only boundary artifacts
require: record center-count parity and coordinate hash
finding: Web verifier checks count, uniqueness and contiguity but not the expected first/last operation identities.
require: carry expected first and last operation numbers in current canonical acceptance contract
require: require served minimum equals expected first
require: require served maximum equals expected last
require: bind range expectations to manifest SHA/revision
require: block shifted contiguous ranges with correct count
finding: Verifier fetches JSON endpoints but does not prove the accepted HTML actually renders those rows for the user.
require: run a bounded rendered-page verification or equivalent DOM receipt
require: require rendered operation row count equals accepted JSON count
require: require rendered source/example counts equal accepted counts
require: require all three measured target rows visible in rendered DOM
require: record DOM/page hash or deterministic render receipt
finding: Source acceptance only checks non-empty publisher and source_url; malformed or unrelated provenance URLs can pass.
require: require HTTPS for external source URLs
require: validate publisher-to-authority domain mapping for EA HMLR OS OGC IETF and approved software docs
require: permit canonical repository references only under explicit canonical-source role
require: reject credentialed localhost javascript data or unrelated domains
require: bind normalized source URL and publisher to source-row SHA
